title: Project 2
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: gain experience working on a project in a team.
apply the skills and knowledge acquired in the other modules so far.
analyse a theme for a game, do research and detect opportunities to deduct rules to play from it.
design, create and present a physical game prototype.
evaluate their prototype e.g., by conducting user tests and recommend improvements.
Design and creation of a physical game, optionally with digital augmentation
Practical application of various skills acquired in previous modules
Work with physical material to create prototypes
